answer: A newcomer earns standing as a raven courier across the meadow: it carries real jobs between strangers, and each delivery counts only when sender and receiver both confirm it, with proof only the real job could produce. Every confirmed relay adds one petal to its lotus; the flower blooms into full privileges only after petals arrive from many unrelated senders and receivers across a season. A farm's accounts relay only to each other, drawing a closed loop on the map that anyone can see and prune, while one forged delivery withers that lotus and sends its owner back to carrying alone.
